description:
Promoted from the gating open_question in
[[uat-clickhouse-server-loader-type-coverage]] (surfaced by the UAT-effort
assessment, 2026-07-16). That item's Bucket A (empty numeric/date source
values) cannot land its DDL/loader work (w2, success_metrics) until this
policy is decided, because the choice changes both the emitted DDL and the
correctness expectation.

The question: for an empty numeric/date value in the source data, should the
ClickHouse-server loader emit/preserve `Nullable(T)` DDL for that column, or
coerce the empty to a type default under a non-Nullable column?

This is a SOUNDNESS-ADJACENT schema decision (it changes stored values and
therefore query answers), so it must be ratified against the benchmark
schema's own nullability semantics rather than chosen for loader
convenience. The parent already records a recommended default (see
recommended_resolution); this item exists to make that call explicit,
ratify it against TPC schema nullability, and record the rejected path as
deferred so the parent's w2 is unambiguous.

anti_patterns.dont: bake a nullability default into the loader without ratifying against the reference schema
duplicate the loader DDL work here
anti_patterns.why: this item is the decision only; the parent implements it.

deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] duplicate: Deferral text names its own owner, uat-clickhouse-server-loader-type-coverage:w2, which is an open, active, high-priority item.
deferrals.summary: Implement the chosen policy in the ClickHouse-server loader/DDL

deferrals.reason: The decision is intentionally exclusive; the unchosen option must not remain pending work.
deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] non-actionable: Reason explicitly states the rejected nullability option must not remain pending work; decision was intentionally exclusive.

prior_art.concept: benchbox reference benchmark schemas (TPC-H/TPC-DS/SSB DDL) — the authority on column nullability; derive the decision from these, not from ClickHouse convenience.
benchbox/core/results comparator/answer-set validation — the soundness surface a wrong coercion would corrupt; consult before ratifying.
uat-clickhouse-server-loader-type-coverage:open_questions — the gating question and its recommended default; this item resolves it, does not restate it.

verifications.description: Parent decision records the resolved nullable-empty policy

work_units.notes:
Confirm the open_question still gates
uat-clickhouse-server-loader-type-coverage:w2 and enumerate the TPC-H /
TPC-DS / SSB columns that are (a) numeric/date and (b) marked nullable vs
non-nullable in the reference schema. Record a compact table.

W0 FINDING (2026-07-16): the question is still open (parent's open_question
is unresolved, now cross-linked via promoted_to). Two load-bearing facts
that arm the recommendation:
  1. Nullability IS first-class in BenchBox schema specs — columns carry an
     explicit `nullable: false` (e.g. benchbox/core/clickbench/
     schema_specs.yaml); absence defaults to nullable. So "preserve
     Nullable where the schema marks it" is a mechanical read of existing
     metadata, not a new judgement per column.
  2. The ClickHouse adapter ALREADY normalises nullability DDL —
     benchbox/sql_compat/rules/ddl_optimize/clickhouse_ddl_rewrites.py and
     benchbox/platforms/clickhouse/workload.py strip `Nullable(T) NOT NULL`
     because ClickHouse rejects the combination. The recommended policy is
     consistent with this existing surface.
A per-column TPC-H/DS/SSB nullable-numeric/date table was NOT fully
enumerated here on purpose: that inventory is Bucket-A-specific and belongs
with the parent loader item's refinement, where the loader path is in
context. w1 (ratification) remains the gate — it is soundness/CODEOWNERS
territory and needs Code Owner sign-off; see anti_patterns.
work_units.summary: Re-validate the question is still open and inventory the affected columns

work_units.notes:
Decide per the recommended_resolution unless w0 surfaces a schema column
where preserving Nullable breaks the reference answer-set. This is the
decision work unit; it needs Code Owner / soundness review because it
touches comparator-relevant behaviour (see anti_patterns).

RATIFIED 2026-07-16 by the repo owner: Nullable-preserve (send NULL, emit
Nullable(T)); no default coercion; fail loudly on empty-into-NOT-NULL.
w0 confirmed every observed failing column is nullable in the reference
schema, so preserving Nullable cannot break their answer-sets. Policy-only
ratification; the loader code (parent w2) still gets CODEOWNERS review.
work_units.summary: Ratify Nullable-preserve vs default-coerce against benchmark schema nullability
